commission_mandated_arithmetic.sampling_error: UNIDENTIFIED; no sample design or variance supplied

R1.defect: The adapter aliased AUTHORIZED_SPARSE_TEMPORAL_KEY and stamped it on results without ever calling the original _authorize_v553_multi_wave_key, which requires a harmonized key plus two qualified anchors.
R1.repair: temporal_key is now RETURNED BY the original _authorize_v553_multi_wave_key, called on the qualified anchor group at the clock. Single eligible anchor can only yield PROBE_ONLY_TEMPORAL_KEY (native reason insufficient_distinct_waves). Native may only DOWNGRADE: an INTERPOLATED_NOT_OBSERVED value stays exploratory even when its anchors are natively AUTHORIZED, mirroring the native gap-segment control that keeps unknown_gap_preserved and interpolation_allowed=false even when the caller passes allow_interpolation=True.
R1.preserved: the original V553 authorization function is not modified; its three-way AUTHORIZED/PROBE/BLOCKED outcomes are reproduced by direct native calls as controls

R2.defect: A floating-point NaN wave produced value=0.0, band=none, AUTHORIZED, no refusal under M0/M1/M2, because _bounded_score was called on an unsupported observation.
R2.repair: Upstream native support validation runs BEFORE any numeric use. Non-finite, non-numeric, None or declared support_status=MISSING observations are typed UNKNOWN with refused_code MISSING_OBSERVATION_NOT_ZERO and temporal_key BLOCKED_TEMPORAL_KEY. Observed zero remains a real zero. Mixed support drops the missing anchor and names it in MISSING_SUPPORT_EXCLUDED.
R2.preserved: the accepted original V553 _bounded_score default-to-0.0 behaviour is untouched and covered by its own control; this is an adapter-contract repair only

R3.defect: Consumer provenance named case.waves[0].source_family and .edition even when that first wave was filtered out as WRONG_SOURCE/WRONG_EDITION, so an excluded source was reported as the supported consumer provenance.
R3.repair: provenance source_family/edition/source_families/editions are bound to the waves actually named in basis_wave_ids. A basis whose (source_family, edition) disagree is refused with BASIS_SOURCE_CONFLICT rather than silently narrowed.

expected_after_repair.excluded_first_wave_then_admissible: provenance source_family == ACTUAL_SOURCE and edition == ACTUAL_EDITION

R4.defect: structurally_identical ignored ROUTE_PARTICIPATION and the rest of the structural-world opportunity inventory, so removing ROUTE_PARTICIPATION from the supplied world at the same clock still returned true while the output changed.
R4.repair: structurally_identical compares the COMPLETE structural/access world identity, carried in provenance.structural_world_fields (world_id, structural_routes, access_grants, institution) plus grain.

R5.defect: At retrospective 1995 the honest .40 PROBE/NOT_OBSERVED estimate nonetheless emitted ROUTE_DEFERRED_REVIEW with no refusal and described its result as a permission-valid open route.
R5.repair: A PROBE_ONLY/exploratory read reports opportunity_ids=[ROUTE_BLOCKED_NO_SUPPORT] and authorized_opportunity=False, and lists the band-implied routes separately in exploratory_route_ids. Only a natively AUTHORIZED observation may present an open permission-valid route.
R5.consequence_disclosed: The original T9B published two-time artifact recorded opportunity_ids=[ROUTE_DEFERRED_REVIEW] for the 1990 PROBE_ONLY read. Repairing R5 necessarily changes that single field. This is a deliberate, disclosed residual deviation from the rejected artifact, not an undisclosed regression. Arithmetic, band, basis, uncertainty and all provenance values are unchanged.

expected_after_repair.probe_only_read: opportunity_ids == [ROUTE_BLOCKED_NO_SUPPORT], authorized_opportunity == False, exploratory_route_ids == band-implied routes
expected_after_repair.authorized_read: opportunity_ids == band-implied routes, authorized_opportunity == True, exploratory_route_ids == []

R6.defect: Query 1997 across the declared 1995 population break carried the pre-break .20 as AUTHORIZED with no rupture caveat, implying the post-break cohort estimand.
R6.repair: A carry that crosses a registered rupture is kept as a TYPED BOUNDED HYPOTHETICAL: value preserved, refused_code still None (so the accepted author positive that a hold still works across a rupture survives), but uncertainty gains POST_RUPTURE_CARRY_HYPOTHETICAL:R1995|IDENTIFIED_SET_UNBOUNDED:STABILITY_NOT_ASSUMED, detail states the post-break cohort estimand is NOT identified, rupture_qualified is True, and temporal_key is downgraded to PROBE_ONLY_TEMPORAL_KEY so no route is opened.

expected_after_repair.post_rupture_M0_M2: value preserved, refused_code None, POST_RUPTURE_CARRY_HYPOTHETICAL in uncertainty, RUPTURE in detail, temporal_key PROBE_ONLY

R7.defect: Retrospective M0 used only W0 yet flagged future W1 as a publication lag on that value, over-inclusive and ambiguous provenance.
R7.repair: publication_lag_wave_ids and pub_lag_of are computed over the BASIS waves only. The unused post-clock archive inventory is published separately as archive_context_wave_ids and is never presented as product publication basis. AS_OF reads carry no archive context at all.

expected_after_repair.M0_retrospective_on_late_publication: pub_lag_of == (DELAYED,) since that wave IS the basis
